title: What followed
outro_say: That completes the series. | Past patterns, before costs. Not a forecast.

steps.say: When a Set turns Yes, does anything different tend to happen next, compared with ordinary days?

steps.screen: A card: how it is measured
steps.say: Each time a Set first turns Yes, we look at the next ten daily candles. | We compare them with ordinary days: the same asset, the same year, and the same side of its long-term average. | Twenty-five coins and sixty-one large US equities, from 2014 to October 2024.

steps.screen: Prism library: Breakout with volume, more…
steps.say: Every provided Set carries the result. | Open more, and the last line is What followed.

Tap it for the numbers. | Breakout with volume turned Yes almost nineteen hundred times. | Price rose a typical move before falling one fifty-one percent of the time, against fifty percent on comparable days.

steps.screen: The same card: coins and equities on their own
steps.say: Under it, coins and equities, each on its own: | here, no clear difference in either, and none between them.
Every study ends in one of four verdicts: | too few to judge, | no clear difference, | some difference, not established, | or a consistent difference.
Most simple setups show no clear difference. | That's an honest, useful answer: they describe a situation; they don't predict one.

Trend alignment is the interesting one. | After the daily and weekly trends first agree, price did a little worse than on comparable days. | Often the weekly trend confirms a move after much of it has happened.

steps.screen: Look inside, Make my own copy, save: the full card in Signal Sets, with the three periods
steps.say: Make your own copy and save it: its study comes with it. | In Signal Sets, the card also shows the three periods side by side,

steps.screen: The luck line, then every asset in name order
steps.say: and every asset on its own, with a luck check. | Ten assets look unusual for this Set, where luck alone typically makes about four. | A place to look closer, not proof.

steps.screen: Signal Sets: Study this Set, then a card: the 🔬 note
steps.say: Your own Sets can be studied too: | open one in Signal Sets, and tap Study this Set. | When it's ready, a note arrives in your notifications.
